title: Anchored Proof Gateway for Jurisdictional Retention and Evidence Bundles
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an "Anchored Proof Gateway" service that centralizes control mapping, artifact collection, and jurisdiction-aware retention policies to produce tamper-evident evidence bundles for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits. The gateway will: (1) map requested audit controls to instrumented collectors and data sources, (2) enforce regional residency and retention rules at ingestion time, (3) attach cryptographic anchors and metadata to evidence artifacts, and (4) export audit-ready bundles with provenance for automated auditor ingestion. This is meant to reduce manual evidence wrangling for compliance reviewers and accelerate attestation cycles for enterprise customers that require region-bound proof and long-term retention guarantees.
tasks: Define control-to-source mapping schema (JSON Schema) and canonical metadata fields
Prototype incoming evidence envelope and anchor format (hash + signed timestamp)
Integrate with existing snapshot/harvest proxies (ENG-76133, ENG-48172) to pull runtime telemetry and audit logs
Implement retention enforcement hooks (S3/GCS lifecycle + internal tombstone index) with per-region TTL
Build evidence bundler that produces signed bundles with manifest and checksum per artifact
Add export endpoints for auditor bundles (ZIP + metadata.json) and streaming exports to secure buckets
Design console UX for mapping controls to collectors and viewing bundle provenance
Write end-to-end tests and a sample auditor import script
acceptance_criteria: Can produce a signed evidence bundle for a sample SOC 2 control containing logs, RBAC snapshots, and config diffs
Retention rules are enforced on ingestion and artifacts scheduled for deletion follow region-specific TTLs
Bundles include a manifest with per-artifact hash, region tag, and cryptographic anchor verifiable via a public key
Console view shows control -> collector mapping and last-run status for each collector
Automated export job can deliver bundles to a customer-owned secure bucket and produce a short-lived signed URL
Onboarding doc and example auditor import script added to the compliance docs
risks_mitigation: Risk: Retention enforcement may conflict with existing lifecycle policies. Mitigation: add an override reconciliation job and a retention policy audit log.
Risk: Cryptographic anchoring adds operational complexity. Mitigation: start with a simple HMAC-SHA256 anchor scheme and roll to HSM-based signatures after MVP.
Risk: Large bundles may hit export timeouts. Mitigation: support chunked bundle streaming and resumable exports.
